title: Steering Out-of-Distribution Generalization with Concept Ablation Fine-Tuning
reasoning: The paper evaluates 'emergent misalignment' in LLMs, which involves models generating responses that violate human values and ethics (e.g., world domination, political assassination, or self-harm). It specifically uses an 'Alignment' judge to score model outputs based on their adherence to human values, which constitutes a benchmark for ethical behavior and alignment.
